segments.text: Good morning, and welcome back to Equi-Tix.
Today we have a special guest with us, Andy Galuli.
Andy is the Vice President of Sales of DK-Lok,
one of our trusted brands and strong partners.
Andy, can you tell me a little bit about DK-Lok?
Well, first off, thank you for having me.
And DK-Lok is an emerging and has been for 25 years
a global manufacturer of instrumentation,
high precision products and solutions
both in the fluid conveyance and testing
and measurement area.
That sounds pretty cool, Andy.
So, Tom here, what are the different applications
that DK-Lok is used for?
Where can I find DK-Lok products?
DK is found in virtual, every industry.
We've seen both major and sub-emerging industries,
find it in oil and gas, find chemical pulp and paper,
also semiconductor and even aerospace.
Can you tell me DK-Lok has been to Mars?
Not quite, but there are discussions
and that discussion hinges on our AS9100 approval
and NADCAP certification.
And so, more to come.
That sounds pretty cool.
So, Tom, obviously DK-Lok is one of the leading brands
in its industry.
Why should people go to DK-Lok
rather than its competitors?
Well, it starts with the piece of mind.
Based on our interchangeability and our warranty
that comes with that with the market leader,
it gives that customer and the market
something that we haven't had
or it hasn't had up until this point.
And that is we will warrant our product
as it's interchanged with that market leader
based on extensive third-party testing.
Also, our certifications.
We've been doing certifications third-party
since inception and those certifications include,
but not limited to ASME, ISO,
NADCAP, AS9100 and the like.
And so, in addition to that,
it's our constant quality measures
through SBC quality management,
which is in real time
at our individual manufacturing facilities.
And we strive to make the best quality product
at the most efficient rate.
So it sounds like it's a no-brainer.
People should go with DK-Lok.
Where can they find DK-Lok?
I don't know of a better place than Equigas.
